title: Senses table: sense and body part
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: The human body and senses (Memory Box and Human Senses)
source: Seeded from science/y1 lesson 11 (Senses table: sense and body part (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 11: Sight and hearing. To understand that we see with our eyes and hear with our ears

questions.q: Which body part do we see with?
questions.model: I close my eyes. I cannot see. I open them. I can see. So I see with my eyes.

questions.q: Clap quietly, then loudly. Which sense did you use?
How many senses do we have?
Look and listen. Draw one thing you can see and one thing you can hear at home.
questions.a: For example: see a clock; hear the kettle
questions.model: Teacher shows it first: I see a cup. I hear a car outside. I draw both.

questions.q: Write one way to keep your ears safe.
questions.a: For example: do not put things in them; turn loud sounds down

questions.q: Big question: which would be harder, eyes closed or ears covered?
questions.a: Any answer with a reason, for example: eyes closed, because I could not see where to walk
